gloss: to wield, to exercise, to display

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {振|ふ}るっていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to wield, to swing, to brandish
definitions.explanation: To swing or brandish a weapon, tool, or implement with force.

definitions.gloss: to exercise, to exert (power, ability, violence)
definitions.explanation: To actively use or display power, ability, or force. Often used when describing someone demonstrating their skills or exerting authority.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理人|りょうりにん}→料理人：19396_ryourinin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}るって⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧さばいた。
examples.english: The chef wielded a knife and filleted the fish.

examples.english: Those in a position to exercise power also bear heavy responsibility.

notes:
{振|ふ}るう means to wield or exercise something with active force — whether a physical tool or an abstract power.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}るう: to wield ~, to exercise ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}るう: to display one's skill (literally "wield one's arm")
- ⟦{暴力|ぼうりょく}→暴力：02528_bouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}るう: to resort to violence
- ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}るう: to wield power
- ⟦{手腕|しゅわん}→手腕：07466_shuwan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}るう: to demonstrate one's abilities
- ⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{振|ふ}るう: to wield a kitchen knife (i.e., to cook)

WATCH OUT:
- {振|ふ}るう (to wield) vs {奮|ふる}う (to rouse oneself, to muster) — different kanji, different meanings
- {振|ふ}るう (to wield) vs ⟦{震|ふる}える→震える：02411_furueru⟧ (to tremble) — different words entirely
